text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: High malformed-token errors on rdlw/gptx-13b-serving v3 rollout in us-west-2. Error rate spike to 6.8% on canary pool. Metric: https://grafana.example/reds/rdlw/err-spike

sam (deploy-bot): automated rollout triggered at 2026-03-15T09:07:12Z -> deploying model version 3.2.1 (weights: wset-20260315-v3, tokenizer: tok-20260308). Canary group: cg-ld-1 (5 nodes).

maya (oncall-sre): acked. paging oncall-ml. I'm seeing increased 5xx and tokenization errors in the logs: "DecoderError: unknown id 0xfff" from the tokenizer layer on several canary hosts.

dmitri (oncall-ml): looking. pulling canary logs now. Seen decoding truncation + replacement tokens like <|UNK|> where normal text expected. Query samples: 
```
input: "Summarize quarterly results"
output: "Summarize quarterly \uFEFF\uFEFF\uFEFF"
```
Not just latency, actual token mis-decoding.

alice (prod-eng): confirmation: rollout config used model artifact wset-20260315-v3 from s3://redwood-models/releases/3.2.1. Hash: sha256:ab12...cd34. Tokenizer referenced tok-20260308 (sha256:11aa...bb22).

ben (support): customer reports: a handful of clients saw garbled responses and then retried; total affected requests ~2.1% of traffic for the hour. No data exfil reported. Customer impact: degraded quality for generation endpoints, some downstream parsing failures.

dmitri (oncall-ml): initial hypothesis: weight artifact corresponds to new tokenizer vocabulary mapping (vocab v6) but rollout referenced an older tokenizer (v5) — mismatch in token ID space. Tools show embed->tokenize mapping diff: several token ids remapped causing decoder to emit invalid ids.

maya (oncall-sre): can we pause or flip a kill-switch? What are options: abort rollout, rollback weights, or pin canary to previous snapshot?

sam (deploy-bot): available actions: 
 - rollback artifact to wset-20260228-stable 
 - toggle feature flag `rollout-model-3-2-1` to off (infra flag) which prevents further promotions 
 - isolate canary nodes by removing them from LB pool
Use `deployctl rollback` or `featurectl toggle` commands.

alice (prod-eng): execute rollback script to previous stable weights and redeploy tokenizers. I'm running: 
```bash
deployctl rollback --model rdlw/gptx-13b-serving --to wset-20260228-stable --region us-west-2 --reason "canary token-id mismatch"
featurectl toggle rollout-model-3-2-1 off --team infra
```

ops-bot: deployctl started rollback job job-id: dj-20260315-4912. ETA ~3m to replace weights on canary nodes.

dmitri (oncall-ml): while rollback runs, snapshotting failing inputs for eval set, saving to /tmp/incident-2080012345/samples.jsonl for forensic. Going to compare token maps.

maya (oncall-sre): removing canary nodes from LB to stop traffic to affected instances. `k8s: cordon cg-ld-1-*` in progress.

ops-bot: canary pods drained; LB adjusted. 503 spikes stopped.

sam (deploy-bot): rollback finished on canary nodes at 2026-03-15T09:12:58Z. Verified checksums: wset-20260228-stable sha256:cd88...ee77. Running smoke tests.

alice (prod-eng): smoke checks: tokenization returns stable, decoder errors gone on canary. Re-running regression suite on sample queries.

ben (support): customers: initial reports show improvement after ~5-7 minutes post-rollback. Informing impacted customers.

dmitri (oncall-ml): root cause confirmed: deployment pipeline bug where tokenizer artifact binding step reads tokenizer id from manifest env var `TOKENIZER_TAG` but for this release the manifest had stale value due to caching in CI. The weights were built against tok-v6 but manifest pointed to tok-v5. Token id remapping caused invalid id emission.

carol (pm): severity assessment for SRE ticket: customer-facing quality regression, partial impact, no data loss. Recommend Sev3. Need postmortem and CI fix priority.

maya (oncall-sre): creating incident ticket INC-2026-0315-2080 with timeline, paging logs attached. Assigning to: dmitri, alice, sam, and infra CI squad.

dmitri (oncall-ml): mitigation steps pending: 
 - CI cache purge on build nodes (PR ready)
 - manifest validation check: verify tokenizer hash against weight build metadata (pre-deploy check)
 - add canary-level compatibility test that checks token-id mapping between tokenizer and weight artifacts
I'll open PRs and link in ticket.

alice (prod-eng): temp control: restrict auto-promote window and require explicit manual approval if tokenizer or vocab changes detected.

ben (support): note for CS: timeline for affected customers and mitigation message drafted, ready to send once postmortem draft approved.

sam (deploy-bot): logged manual hold: `rollout-hold: true` on pipeline for model rdlw/gptx-13b-serving.

ops-bot: handoff reminder: oncall-ml shift ends in 1h. Please document remaining actions in the ticket.

dmitri (oncall-ml): will create PRs and leave TODOs in INC-2026-0315-2080. Handing off to next oncall: @maya if anything flares in the next 30m ping me.

maya (oncall-sre): monitoring for 30m post-rollback. Metrics returning to baseline. Closing paging for now.

incident-bot: Incident update: status -> mitigated (canary rollback complete). Next steps: postmortem in 72h, CI fix in next sprint, update runbook. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0315-2080

carol (pm): thanks everyone. Please add action owners and ETA to the ticket. We'll triage backlog priority in tomorrow standup. :white_check_mark:
